$comment: The Waveshare ESP32-S3-Matrix (boards/waveshare-esp32-s3-matrix.json) for `zinc run --simulate esp32-s3-matrix`: an 8x8 LED matrix and a QMI8658 motion sensor (accelerometer and gyroscope, read through zinc:imu). Turn it in the panel and the matrix turns; tilt it and what falls follows.
